nodes.label: 7. Cosas que cambian el plan del issue
nodes.norm_label: 7. cosas que cambian el plan del issue

nodes.label: Transformer local en el navegador (spike, descartado para hoy)
nodes.norm_label: transformer local en el navegador (spike, descartado para hoy)

nodes.label: memoria.json (hechos aprendidos)
nodes.rationale: Learned facts kept apart from the fixed profile; each fact has origin, importance, date and active/invalidated state.

nodes.label: claude -p
nodes.rationale: OAuth tokens not allowed in other products; grey zone for hackathon.

nodes.label: Gemini Flash free tier
nodes.rationale: Free tier uses data for training: relevant for a sick person's conversations.

nodes.label: Propuesta memoria en tres capas (perfil, estilo, hechos)
nodes.norm_label: propuesta memoria en tres capas (perfil, estilo, hechos)

nodes.label: Sleep-time compute (Letta)
nodes.rationale: Consolidate memory between conversations, off the critical path.

nodes.label: Agente de memoria
nodes.rationale: Never runs during a turno to stay off the latency-critical path.

nodes.label: Hecho
nodes.rationale: Contradicted facts are invalidated, not deleted, to preserve history.

nodes.label: Mem0 (ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP)
nodes.rationale: Compare against existing memories before writing; Mem0g invalidates instead of deleting.

nodes.label: SocializeChat (cercania + memoria personal)
nodes.rationale: Closest prior work: closeness levels gate memory detail; but hallucinated facts and no write-back.

nodes.label: The less I type, the better (Valencia et al., CHI 2023)
nodes.norm_label: the less i type, the better (valencia et al., chi 2023)

nodes.label: Extraer de la conversacion cruda, no del resumen
nodes.norm_label: extraer de la conversacion cruda, no del resumen
nodes.rationale: Raw episodes beat summaries on LoCoMo/LongMemEval (0.826 vs 0.675).

nodes.label: Few-shot con frases reales del usuario
nodes.norm_label: few-shot con frases reales del usuario
nodes.rationale: Real examples give up to 23.5x more style match than descriptions.

nodes.label: Hibrido JSON en disco + markdown en prompt
nodes.norm_label: hibrido json en disco + markdown en prompt
nodes.rationale: JSON allows typed Mem0-style ops; markdown is readable and goes directly into the prompt.

nodes.label: Riesgos: palabras en la boca, hechos inventados, integridad contextual
nodes.norm_label: riesgos: palabras en la boca, hechos inventados, integridad contextual

nodes.label: Orden de opciones por probabilidad
nodes.rationale: In scanning, position is time (Huffman scanning).

nodes.label: src/eventos.ts contrato compartido
nodes.rationale: Prefer adding events over renaming/deleting to avoid breaking parallel paths.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 breaking changes rule
nodes.rationale: Training data may be outdated; read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code.

nodes.label: Fase 0 (research + grill)
nodes.rationale: Each path researches and grills the plan before coding; findings in docs/research/<path>.md, decisions as issue comments.

nodes.label: Push directo a main con pull --rebase
nodes.norm_label: push directo a main con pull --rebase

nodes.label: Paths paralelos (path:* issues)
nodes.rationale: 4 Claude accounts in a 5-hour hackathon, one path each, touching only owned folders.

nodes.label: Segmentacion por gap de inactividad + chequeo LLM
nodes.norm_label: segmentacion por gap de inactividad + chequeo llm

nodes.label: Cercania
nodes.rationale: Optional, never set by the user via barrido (too costly); defines tone and which facts may be used.

nodes.label: Conversacion
nodes.rationale: Detected automatically (>15 min new, <3 min same, LLM decides in between) since the user cannot manage UI.

nodes.label: Urgencia
nodes.rationale: Never goes through the LLM; always available.

nodes.label: I, Robot? (autoetnografia AAC 2025)
nodes.rationale: Monolithic memory leaked intimate details across contexts; recommends separate editable modules.

nodes.label: Fin de turno por silencio (~1200 ms) + disparo manual
nodes.norm_label: fin de turno por silencio (~1200 ms) + disparo manual
nodes.rationale: Cutting early costs more than waiting since the user takes seconds to choose.

nodes.label: Senales de aprendizaje (opcion, Otra, deletreo, interlocutor)
nodes.norm_label: senales de aprendizaje (opcion, otra, deletreo, interlocutor)

nodes.label: Modelo de estados (escuchando, pensando, opciones, sinConexion, hablando...)
nodes.norm_label: modelo de estados (escuchando, pensando, opciones, sinconexion, hablando...)

nodes.label: Aviso
nodes.rationale: Makes the room go silent; recognition is off from the aviso until speech ends.

nodes.label: Parpadeo largo
nodes.rationale: 500 ms threshold so normal blinks are ignored.

nodes.label: Half-duplex (abort() durante aviso y habla)
nodes.rationale: Chrome recognition opens the mic without echo cancellation; loud speakers would make the system transcribe itself.

nodes.label: Drift de estilo
nodes.rationale: Chosen options are a biased LLM-generated signal; spelled text is the user's free voice and weighs more.

nodes.label: Barrido lineal 1,2 s ajustable
nodes.rationale: With 9 elements linear suffices; row-column needs 2 long blinks per choice.

nodes.label: Congelar barrido mientras ojos.cerrados
nodes.rationale: 500 ms long blink vs 1.2 s step would otherwise select the wrong element.

nodes.label: Diseno para ELA (baja carga cognitiva, sin rojo salvo urgencia)
nodes.norm_label: diseno para ela (baja carga cognitiva, sin rojo salvo urgencia)

nodes.label: .data/ storage en servidor
nodes.rationale: Local file storage; does not persist on Vercel.

nodes.label: Onboarding
nodes.rationale: Under 10 minutes by a family member; content marked as said about the user, not by the user.

nodes.label: Perfil
nodes.rationale: Family-loaded base of the huella; learning never modifies it to avoid drift.

nodes.label: Reglas del prompt fijas en codigo
nodes.norm_label: reglas del prompt fijas en codigo
nodes.rationale: Automatic improvement only touches the huella, never the rules.

nodes.label: Sin base vectorial
nodes.rationale: With tens of facts, importance + recency + keyword match suffice.

nodes.label: Bug de corte ~15 s de voces Google
nodes.norm_label: bug de corte ~15 s de voces google

nodes.label: Chrome recognition sin cancelacion de eco (Chromium source)
nodes.norm_label: chrome recognition sin cancelacion de eco (chromium source)

nodes.label: ElevenLabs Instant Voice Cloning ('la voz de Roberto')
nodes.norm_label: elevenlabs instant voice cloning ('la voz de roberto')

nodes.label: Relanzado en onend con flag deberiaEscuchar
nodes.norm_label: relanzado en onend con flag deberiaescuchar

nodes.label: Reconocimiento de Chrome como base y fallback permanente
nodes.norm_label: reconocimiento de chrome como base y fallback permanente
nodes.rationale: Free, no backend; improvements (Deepgram, on-device) layer on top.

nodes.label: Sin barge-in
nodes.rationale: Nobody can interrupt the system while speaking except urgencia.

nodes.label: Microfono cardioide de mesa hacia la ronda
nodes.norm_label: microfono cardioide de mesa hacia la ronda

nodes.label: Telegram Bot API para aviso al contacto
nodes.norm_label: telegram bot api para aviso al contacto
nodes.rationale: Fastest official free API with push notification; ntfy.sh as plan B.
